LanguageData.WotF_Super_Tornado.description: One of the legendary supra runes.\nRaises an all-consuming tempest of flame at the chosen point, searing anyone caught within—and clinging embers keep burning for a moment even after escape.\nOnce a scorched-earth measure used by the ancients to purge runaway ecosystems and reshape atmospheres, it now survives sealed in rune form solely as an emblem of ruin.
LanguageData.WotF_Super_Tornado.label: flame tornado
